title: Andrew Ng launches OpenWorker AI co-worker with local data #OpenWorker #AndrewNg #machinelearning
description: Andrew Ng released OpenWorker, an AI co-worker that completes tasks rather than just chatting. It integrates with over 40 apps like Slack, Calendar, and Files, automating replies, scheduling, and document preparation while checking in before taking major actions. OpenWorker runs entirely on your Mac, allowing you to use various AI models such as Fable, GPT 5.6, Sol, Kimi K3, DeepSeek, or run Olama locally. This keeps your data private unless you choose to share it. The platform represents a shift towards practical, trustworthy AI automation in everyday workflows. By enabling seamless interaction with multiple apps and maintaining user control over data, OpenWorker sets a new standard for AI productivity tools in professional environments. #AndrewNg #OpenWorker #AIautomation #ArtificialIntelligence #MacAI #AICoWorker #MachineLearning #GPT5 #GoogleBrain #BaiduAI #ProductivityAI #LocalAI #AImodels #TechInnovation #WorkflowAutomation
